notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Hey there!

Today's update is a bit smaller than usually expected, but we did not want the frequency of the updates to be demolished.

We made some changes on the Map Textures now the cliffs no longer have dull green color but someting much more exciting!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736569/371f48c8df5d1a6559f823b77e5d9bdebc568149.gif

Sorry for the small update but we are working on something much bigger in the background. :D

See you soon!

notes.title: Latest Patch - Collectables!
notes.content:
Hello there!

In today's update we finally managed to add collactables!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736569/6be249256bf5353beacb5cbc6639149aec8309e1.gif

These skulls in the forest are your items to collect.If you collect all of them you can continue to the next level, this way we are starting to implement a few basic mechanics to the game wehich we intended in the first place!
As of now you won't be able to find a counter for the objects, as we wanted to feature them on the pause menu to not ruin the player experince for those, who make those beautiful screenshots from out little fox! However we will implement it as soon as possible.
We did not want players who don't ususally read Patch Notes to not inerstand why they can't move to the next area so as for now you can switch between the areas as you wish from the start.
But you can already start collecting! There are 5 skulls each stage you can encounter. On both map different kind of bones can be found:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736569/4a416f23e08eaf6a446d7240ec898bf1dbf5837c.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736569/ecf13ff6f3e7ec6a8fd0157787a8400785a400e8.jpg

The feature is not available in the Test Area however a new little companion will follow you through your visit there. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736569/8b714c9fbc747ce41938b0b02b8e099fc644e631.gif

Happy Treasure Hunting!

notes.title: Latest Patch
notes.content:
Hi!
It has been a while since we last reported in the game's status.
Fortunately we are happy to announce that we improved our variety of maps with one addition, now with the temporary name: 'Test Map'
Our goal is to create a connected universe each with it's own theme and atmosphere, so don't be tricked with the distinguishing, this map will also be featured in the final build. 
But before all this, it also has another function: testing out our new mechanics (collectibles, new AI system, more detailed environment). For this particular reason, we designed a whole different start button, accessible in the Main Menu. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736569/641e0654bc6467a898957088609f3d65fc76c09a.png
We would like to make small updates to it every 2-3 days, but don't be surprised if something goes wrong, while playing it.

If you have any issues playing the new mode, please report it under the "Report a Bug" topic. 
Thank you for following the development of our game!

notes.title: Our Biggest Update Yet!
notes.content:
Patch 0.5.9:

New Map!
As of now a den is waiting the curious players if entered, a new world can be encountered.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736569/172dbaf11ff1ea6016272395bd290180335d50d7.png

Updated soundtrack!
We were very keen on updating our vocals, as we found them quite monoton if played on loop.

Minor updates:
-Bug fixes
-More animals
-Fixed animal AI

Thank you for following the development of Brood!

notes.title: Latest Patch
notes.content:
New Feature:
Wildlife
As of now various species of animals can be encountered on your journey.

Fixes:
More responsive camera
The map has been altered a little, making your game experience more of a joy!

In the next few updates we'll be focusing on making the animal AI more responsive towards the player.

Update 2019.04.27.
New Restart Menu
Wandering animals AI fix

As of now, we had fixed every issue reported in the Bug Report. If any inconvenience occurs, please write a report on the page or contact us at:
lightfoxunity@gmail.com
Thank you for following the development of Brood!
